id.description: The unique identifier for the rental recognition record.

userId.description: The unique identifier for the user.

title.description: Title of the user the rental record belongs to.

firstName.description: First name of the user the rental record belongs to.

lastName.description: Last name of the user the rental record belongs to.

birthdate.description: Date of birth of the user the rental record belongs to.

addressLine1.description: First line of the rented address.

addressLine2.description: Second line of the rented address.

addressLine3.description: Third line of the rented address.

addressLine4.description: Fourth line of the rented address.

tenancyStartDate.description: Start date of the tenancy agreement.

value.description: The amount of the regular rental transactions in minor units of the currency e.g. pennies for GBP.

majorUnits.description: The major units of the value, based on the values currency, eg. pounds for GBP.

minorUnits.description: The minor units of the value, based on the values currency, eg. pennies for GBP.

rentalAmount.description: The value of the balance in minor units of the currency, eg. pennies for GBP.

rentalFrequency.description: Frequency of the rental payments e.g. monthly.

seriesId.description: The unique identity of the regular transaction series.

createdAt.description: The date at which the rental record was added.

modifiedAt.description: The date at which the rental was modified.

lastSubmittedDate.description: The date rental record data was last sent to Experian.

consentApprovedAt.description: The date on which consent to send data to Experian was given.
